definitions.explanation: Expression used to cite a source of information. Indicates that the following statement is based on information from the mentioned source.

examples.japanese: {天気|てんき}{予報|よほう}によると、{明日|あした}は{雨|あめ}だそうです。
examples.english: According to the weather forecast, it will rain tomorrow.

examples.japanese: {新聞|しんぶん}によると、{事故|じこ}があったらしい。
examples.english: According to the newspaper, there seems to have been an accident.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}によると、{会議|かいぎ}は{中止|ちゅうし}になったということだ。
examples.english: According to him, the meeting was cancelled.

notes:
FORMATION: Noun (source) + によると

COMMON SOURCES:
- {新聞|しんぶん}によると (according to the newspaper)
- {天気|てんき}{予報|よほう}によると (according to the forecast)
- {先生|せんせい}によると (according to the teacher)
- {彼|かれ}/{彼女|かのじょ}によると (according to him/her)
- ニュースによると (according to the news)
- {調査|ちょうさ}によると (according to research)

OFTEN PAIRED WITH:
- 〜そうです (hearsay)
- 〜らしいです (it seems)
- 〜ということです (it is said that)

VARIATION: 〜によれば is a more formal/written alternative with the same meaning.

REGISTER: Neutral. Common in both spoken and written Japanese.
